author: reek
body: The device-buffer allocator over the GPU command-buffer window. The opening declares Gpu.Memory, so the boot grant derived from its own manifest carries bit 18 and every window access lands; without it the guarded writes would return -1 and the readback would not match.

author: reek
body: It allocates a buffer from four host words, reads them back, frees the buffer, and allocates again -- the reuse of the same address is the evidence that LIFO free rewound the bump cursor rather than pretending.
